$$

Now, we compute the image of $X$ under $T$ by calculating the matrix product $TX:$

$$
\begin{aligned}TX & =\begin{bmatrix}1 & 3 \\ 3 & 9\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}0 & -2 & 3 \\ -1 & 1 & 0\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}-3 & 1 & 3 \\ -9 & 3 & 9\end{bmatrix}.\end{aligned}
$$

where $R(\lambda Δx)$ is the stability function of the method. The set of values for which the method is stable, given by $|R(\lambda Δx)|<1,$ is called the stability region of the method.
